news.title: Season 4: The Eternal Realms Launches
news.author: Evolisca Team
news.summary: Evolisca Season 4 delivers a complete evolution of the classic EVO experience, combining nostalgic 8.6 gameplay with modern RPG and MMO systems.
news.content: The 4th season of Evolisca brings unprecedented changes to the core gameplay experience. This season focuses on rebalancing progression systems, introducing the Talent System as a core feature, and completely reworking the market and achievement systems. Server launch is scheduled for April 3rd, 2026 at 20:00 GMT +2.
key_changes: Complete rework of Market system with Cosmetics Tracker
Evolisca Tokens added as tradable currency with bank support
Removed roulette and event EXP potions
Removed global EXP requirement for bosses
New Town Expansion with additional hunts and quests

news.title: Server Update - Patch Notes
news.author: Evolisca Team
news.summary: Server maintenance with player relocation, full stamina reset, and various bug fixes.
news.content: This server update includes important bug fixes and adjustments to ensure fair gameplay. All players will be relocated to their temple, and everyone will receive full stamina upon login.
patch_details: All players relocated to their temple
Ward Barbarian Boss entry level fixed
Demon Skeleton, Dragon, Bog Raider, and Wailing Widow task limits increased to level 400
Monsters in level 200+ areas increased to level 800
Potions no longer removed from players under Level 300
Join us now and enjoy the journey!

news.title: Comprehensive Changelog - June 2025
news.author: Evolisca Team
news.summary: Major systems overhaul including no-bot spawning system, set bonuses, challenge rooms, bounce system, and more.
highlights: No-Bot Spawning System with 2x density and +30% exp/loot
Challenge Room System for level 1500+ players
Recover EXP System allowing 25% recovery on death
Boss Access System with daily charges

news.title: Mini Update 2.3 - Bug Fixes and Balance
news.author: Evolisca Team
news.summary: Fixed bugs and adjusted monster experience values for better balance.
news.content: This update focuses on resolving reported issues and balancing monster experience values. Several spawn issues have been fixed, and new tasks have been added.
fixes: Fixed Destma NPC in Lich spawn
Increased experience for multiple monster types
Decreased Spiky Carnivore task kill requirement
Added tasks for Nexweaver and Metal Gargoyle spawns
Nyx Boss level requirement changed to 4000+

news.title: Mini Update 2.2 - Spawn Parchment & New Quest
news.author: Evolisca Team
news.summary: Reduced Spawn Parchment cooldown and introduced Talent Reset Adventure quest.
news.content: This update brings quality of life improvements and new quest content for players looking to progress their talents.
features: Spawn Parchment cooldown reduced from 6 hours to 3 hours
Additional rooms added to Spawn Parchment
Defeating boss grants 10% chance for Krakoloss mount unlock
New Talent Reset Adventure quest introduced
Quest grants reset of talents without item cost
Quest unlocks new boss: Arcane Pulsator

news.title: Beta Phase 1 Complete - Moving Forward
news.author: Evolisca Team
news.summary: Beta Phase 1 has been successfully completed with focus on stability and balance.
news.content: The community's feedback during Beta Phase 1 has been invaluable. We've focused on stability and balance improvements. Phase 2 will introduce more content while maintaining what the community loves about the server.
news.phase_info: Beta Phase 1 focused on stability and balance testing. Phase 2 will introduce additional content. Players can request suggestions and quality-of-life improvements via Discord.
